The '''Esh-kha stasis vault''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Stasis vault|statis vault]], one of many on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] used to contain the [[Esh-kha]]. This particular vault was located in the [[Caves of the Primeval Wardens]] in [[the Tomb]], and imprisoned the followers of the Esh-kha revolutionary [[Hallow Voice]].
